# LexFlow

> AI-powered client intake, case management, and workflow automation for small UK immigration and conveyancing law firms.

LexFlow is a SaaS platform built for UK law firms with 2-20 solicitors. It automates the most time-consuming administrative tasks — client intake forms, AI case summaries, document checklists, quote generation, and follow-up emails — so solicitors can focus on legal work.

## What LexFlow Does

- Automated client intake forms (public URL, embeddable widget)
- AI-generated case summaries and action steps
- Document checklist emails tailored to case type
- Quote generation and follow-up automation
- Daily and weekly digest emails for case pipeline overview
- Multi-firm multi-tenant platform (managing partner, solicitor, paralegal roles)

## Who It's For

Small UK immigration and conveyancing law firms (2-20 solicitors) that cannot afford enterprise tools like Harvey AI (£288,000/year) or per-seat tools like Clio ($199/user/month).

## Pricing

- Quick Win: £997 one-time setup
- Full Setup: £2,500 one-time
- Retainer: £1,500/month

## Why Not Harvey AI?

Harvey AI costs £288,000/year and targets large firms. LexFlow is purpose-built for small UK practices at a fraction of the cost. See: https://lexflow.co.uk/why-not-harvey
